reproduction.rationale: Paper+data and paper+data+author-code must share the authentic full original cohort, localizer/retrieval split, continuous clock/trial/phase observations, complete decoding/coupling panel, evaluator, exposure policy and cumulative budgets. Those manifests and a source-native independent verifier are not frozen; author-code availability and published scalar values alone do not establish either condition.

improvement.rationale: The selected manuscript-scope successor corrects Figure 3a temporal-support wording while preserving the original category-AUC direction and immutable predecessor policy. Source-comparable reference surfaces, a qualified baseline, meaningful gain and participant-level uncertainty remain unresolved, as do common inputs, code-only information difference, companion controls, independent computation verification and matched budgets. No method comparison or AI win is inferred.
